label: Index projection
type: returning only the index keys a query actually needs from an index scan, rather than all of them. Member of index:index-pushdown. Available since Couchbase Server 5.0 - one of only two members this corpus dates at all.
recurrence_note: Four files discounted to 3 independent sources: `shared`, discount upheld. Absorbs the `n1ql:index-projection` fork (1 file) as an alias - see the note.
note: PROMOTED, and it resolves a namespace fork. `index:index-projection` (4 files) and `n1ql:index-projection` (1 file) are one concept spelled in two namespaces; recurrence.py --forks reports the pair, and variant_key() never clustered them because it strips punctuation while keeping the prefix. Aliased rather than rewritten, which is the additive move: rewriting the local spelling in past extraction records is a migration, and this project does not edit history to make a count come out right.
relates_to_competency_question: What work does the Index service do on the Query service's behalf, and what is left over?
